events.title: Post-2010 map
events.text: The General Assembly drew new lines after the 2010 census; the map was upheld in a 2012 referendum.

events.title: Benisek v. Lamone
events.text: A challenge to the 6th district reached the Supreme Court, which ruled with Rucho v. Common Cause that federal courts cannot decide partisan gerrymandering claims.

events.title: State court strikes the first 2022 map
events.text: A Maryland judge found the first post-2020 map an extreme partisan gerrymander; the legislature passed a new map used from 2023.
